text: No fires were detected on the asset during the evaluated period (2026-09-25 to 2026-10-24) based on NASA FIRMS thermal anomaly data. The analysis covered the asset for all days except the last two (2026-10-24 to 2026-10-25) due to data gaps. No thermal detections were recorded from any of the sensors (MODIS, VIIRS_SNPP, VIIRS_NOAA20, or VIIRS_NOAA21) during the covered days. However, it’s important to note that small, short-lived, or cloud-obscured fires might not be detected by these systems.
